title: pavonia nepetifolia
intro: Pavonia nepetifolia, commonly known as Rose Mallow or Pavonia, is a plant species in the mallow family that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Pavonia nepetifolia include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exert antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Pavonia nepetifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
